scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A woman in cream and red robes calls out from stone steps in a sunlit village square, one hand raised beside her mouth and the other extended, while villagers turn toward her.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative personification of wisdom calling out and understanding raising her voice in Proverbs 8:1.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A woman in a red mantle stands with open arms on a rocky, sunlit hill above the meeting of several roads. Travelers walk along the paths through a landscape of trees, stone walls, hills, and distant villages.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of Wisdom standing on a high place beside the way, where paths meet, in Proverbs 8:2.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A woman gestures and calls to travelers beside the open wooden gates of a sunlit stone city, while several people turn toward her.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of Wisdom crying out beside the gates at the entrance to the city in Proverbs 8:3.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A woman in a red robe stands at a stone town gate with one arm extended, speaking to travelers who look toward her; a donkey and sunlit hills appear behind them.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of Wisdom calling to people, reflecting Proverbs 8:4.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A woman gestures toward a stone path leading to a walled city as four people listen and consider her words beneath an olive tree.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative picture of Wisdom calling the simple to prudence and understanding of heart in Proverbs 8:5.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A woman in a cream robe and burgundy shawl speaks with an outstretched hand to a group of attentive listeners gathered beside a sunlit stone city gate.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of Wisdom inviting listeners to hear the excellent and right things she speaks in Proverbs 8:6.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A woman in blue and white speaks with an open hand to seated listeners beneath a leafy tree in a sunlit ancient marketplace. Nearby, a trader holds a pouch beside a balance and another outstretched hand.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of Wisdom speaking to listeners, recalling Proverbs 8:7 and its contrast between speaking truth and rejecting wickedness.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A woman speaks to a group gathered beneath a tree in a sunlit stone courtyard, gesturing toward a straight stone path leading to a village among hills.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative portrayal of Wisdom speaking, with the straight path suggesting the righteousness and freedom from crookedness of her words in Proverbs 8:8.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A woman gestures toward a sunlit path through an olive-dotted landscape as a man with a walking staff listens beside her. A village and mountains rise in the distance.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene using a clear path and an attentive listener to evoke Proverbs 8:9: wisdom’s words are plain to the one who understands and right to those who find knowledge.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A woman teaches two young learners as they tend an olive sapling in a sunny stone courtyard. An open chest of silver and gold sits untouched nearby, with olive trees and hills in the distance.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene for Proverbs 8:10, depicting the choice to receive instruction and knowledge instead of silver and choice gold.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A woman gestures while teaching a young listener beneath an olive tree in a sunny stone courtyard; beside them, an open chest overflows with red gems and gold ornaments.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene for Proverbs 8:11, showing a listener attending to Wisdom beside rubies and treasures that cannot compare with her.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Two women in an ancient stone courtyard study a small garden and irrigation model on a wooden table; one places a pebble beside its water channel. Olive trees and distant hills lie beyond them.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of Wisdom and prudence planning together evokes Proverbs 8:12, where Wisdom dwells with prudence and finds knowledge of discretion.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A traveler with a lowered head raises an open hand as he walks away from a richly dressed, gesturing man and a companion whispering beside thorn bushes. A sunlit stone path leads toward a village in the distance.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of turning away from pride, corrupt speech, and an evil path, reflecting Proverbs 8:13 and its link between reverence for Yahweh and hatred of evil.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A woman gestures toward a stone bridge while a seated builder listens beside a drawing of the bridge; workers build above a stream in a sunlit village landscape.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of Wisdom offering counsel, with the sturdy bridge suggesting the sound wisdom, understanding, and strength of Proverbs 8:14.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit court, a woman in blue and white robes gestures toward a crowned king and other seated rulers. A balance stands between them, while several people listen in the foreground.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of Wisdom addressing rulers, reflecting Proverbs 8:15: by wisdom kings reign and rulers decree justice.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A woman in white and green robes gestures to attentive rulers beside an ancient stone city gate, while two seated judges listen to townspeople nearby.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of Wisdom counseling rulers and judges, reflecting Proverbs 8:16.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: At sunrise, a smiling woman in a blue mantle welcomes a man and a woman at an open garden gate, surrounded by flowers, olive trees and stone walls.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative portrayal of Wisdom welcoming those who love and diligently seek her, as in Proverbs 8:17.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A woman in embroidered robes pours grain into a sack held by a man as a woman and two children look on. Coins, vessels and stored grain sit nearby in a sunlit stone courtyard, with an olive tree and orchard beyond.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene presents Wisdom's riches, honor, enduring wealth and righteousness through treasure, abundance and an act of generosity.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit orchard, a woman offers a seated man a basket of figs and pomegranates. Gold pieces and silver vessels rest on a stone table nearby, with trees and a village in the distance.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene illustrating Wisdom’s fruit and yield as more precious than gold and choice silver in Proverbs 8:19.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A woman walks along a stone path where village paths meet, while two men measure grain beside a market stall among olive trees and distant hills.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of Wisdom walking in the way of righteousness amid the paths of justice in Proverbs 8:20.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A woman in blue and white robes pours gold coins from a vessel into an open treasure chest while four people gather around her in a sunlit stone courtyard.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative portrayal of Wisdom filling the treasuries of those who love her, as described in Proverbs 8:21.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A robed woman stands on a rocky edge, looking toward a golden light above a vast swirling blue and violet expanse.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of Wisdom at the beginning of Yahweh’s way, before His works of old, in Proverbs 8:22.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A woman in a flowing cream robe and blue mantle stands with her arms open amid swirling golden and blue light, with no landscape visible.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative picture of personified Wisdom, established from the beginning before the earth, as described in Proverbs 8:23.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A robed woman stands with open arms in warm golden light above a dry, rocky landscape of empty basins, with distant mountains beneath a cloud-filled sky.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative portrayal of Wisdom brought forth before the depths and water-filled fountains, as described in Proverbs 8:24.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A woman in flowing cream and green robes stands with open arms amid golden light, as mountains and hills rise through swirling mist behind her.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative personification of Wisdom before the mountains were settled and the hills existed, as described in Proverbs 8:25.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Golden light streams through blue and cream clouds over a sweeping swirl of earth-colored dust and small stones.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene evokes the time before God made the earth, fields, and the first dust of the world in Proverbs 8:26.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A woman seated on a rocky shore looks toward a luminous curved horizon over deep blue waves, beneath golden clouds and a star-filled sky.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of Wisdom present when God prepared the heavens and drew a circle on the face of the deep in Proverbs 8:27.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Sunlit clouds tower over a rocky sea, where tall white fountains rise among blue waves and water cascades over the foreground rocks.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative rendering of Proverbs 8:28: clouds established above and the fountains of the deep strengthened.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Turquoise waves break along a curving sandy and rocky coast beside a tall cliff of exposed, multicolored rock layers. Golden sunlight shines over the sea, with hills and mountains in the distance.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene evoking Proverbs 8:29, where God sets a limit for the sea and marks out the foundations of the earth.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A smiling woman in ancient robes shapes a clay bowl at a stone workbench and looks toward golden light above a mountainous coast, surrounded by flowers, birds, and a deer.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative portrayal of personified Wisdom as a craftswoman rejoicing in the Creator’s presence, inspired by Proverbs 8:30.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A smiling woman in a green robe walks hand in hand with children through a sunlit field of flowers, accompanied by a man carrying a basket of fruit, another woman with a jar, and a lamb. Fields, a village, a winding stream, and hills stretch behind them.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene portrays Wisdom rejoicing in the inhabited world and delighting in humankind, as described in Proverbs 8:31.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A woman gestures toward a sunlit valley as four children look up at her while walking together along a winding path, surrounded by flowers, trees, fields, and distant hills.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative picture of Wisdom calling her children to listen and of the blessing of keeping her ways in Proverbs 8:32.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone courtyard, a woman gestures as children and adults listen around a young olive tree; one young woman tends the soil at its base.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene reflects the call to hear instruction, become wise, and not disdain it.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A robed man sits beside a stone doorway, listening to a woman who gestures from inside the open gate. Warm sunlight illuminates the threshold, plants, and a distant town.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of listening and waiting at Wisdom's doorway, inspired by Proverbs 8:34.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A smiling woman in blue and white robes welcomes a traveler beside a clear cascading spring in a sunlit garden of flowers and pomegranate trees.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of finding Wisdom, with the living garden and sunlight suggesting the life and favor from Yahweh described in Proverbs 8:35.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A traveler turns away from a woman reaching out at the flower-covered gate of a sunlit garden and walks along a barren path toward a stone tomb beneath a leafless tree.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene portrays turning away from Wisdom as a path toward harm and death, echoing Proverbs 8:36.
